## New artifact checklist

- [ ] One artifact, in `artifacts/<slug>/` (and `media/<slug>/` if I ran capture). Nothing else changed.
- [ ] `about.md` follows [docs/WRITEUPS.md](https://github.com/dogum/artifact-shelf/blob/main/docs/WRITEUPS.md), has `author:` set to my name, and `status: published`.
- [ ] `npm run check -- <slug>` shows no ✗ errors.
- [ ] I looked at it with `npm run dev` on a desktop and a phone-sized window.
- [ ] I made it (with or without an AI model), I have the right to share everything in it, and it can go out under the MIT License (or the open license I named in Notes).
- [ ] No personal details, tracking, ads or private `claude.ai/artifact/…` links.

## Site change checklist

- [ ] `npm test` passes (and `npm run test:browser` if I touched `shelf.js` or a template).
- [ ] No new runtime dependencies; links go through `L()`.
- [ ] Screenshots attached for visible changes (desktop and phone, light and dark).
